info.name: Nurtiva Tutor Platform API
info.description: Complete, production-ready Postman collection for Nurtiva Tutor Platform (Parent, Tutor, Admin). Automatically captures and applies Bearer JWT token on login.

item.name: Master Data
item.description:
**Purpose:** Public taxonomies for dropdowns, search filters, and profile registration.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public.

item.name: Get all active categories with their subjects

request.description:
**Purpose:** Public taxonomies for dropdowns, search filters, and profile registration.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public.

item.name: List all categories (Admin view including inactive)

request.description: **Access Level:** 🛡️ ADMIN ONLY.

item.name: Create a new educational category

request.description: **Access Level:** 🛡️ ADMIN ONLY.

item.name: Add a new subject to a category

request.description: **Access Level:** 🛡️ ADMIN ONLY.

item.name: Admin
item.description:
**Purpose:** Returns platform-wide aggregate counts: total registered tutors, approved tutors, active parents,
connections initiated, appointments completed, and total platform revenue.
**Access Level:** 🛡️ ADMIN ONLY.

item.name: Retrieve executive dashboard KPIs & metrics

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns platform-wide aggregate counts: total registered tutors, approved tutors, active parents,
connections initiated, appointments completed, and total platform revenue.
**Access Level:** 🛡️ ADMIN ONLY.

item.name: Get detailed financial analytics & revenue breakdowns

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns monthly and weekly revenue trends, transaction volume, and coin package distributions.
**Access Level:** 🛡️ ADMIN ONLY.

item.name: List tutor registration and verification requests

request.description:
**Purpose:** Lists all tutors awaiting review, their submitted qualifications, subjects, and ID proofs.
**Access Level:** 🛡️ ADMIN ONLY.

item.name: Approve or reject a tutor verification request

request.description:
**Purpose:** Approves a tutor (making their profile publicly searchable) or rejects with a reason.
**Access Level:** 🛡️ ADMIN ONLY.

item.name: View all parent-tutor connection leads

request.description:
**Purpose:** Displays platform-wide lead interactions, matchmaking rates, and conversation statuses.
**Access Level:** 🛡️ ADMIN ONLY.

item.name: Platform payment transaction history

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns comprehensive list of all Razorpay payment records, amounts, statuses, and user accounts.
**Access Level:** 🛡️ ADMIN ONLY.

item.name: Moderate review visibility (Publish or Hide)

request.description:
**Purpose:** Allows administrators to toggle a review's status between `published` and `hidden` to prevent spam/abuse.
**Access Level:** 🛡️ ADMIN ONLY.

item.name: Resolve or update complaint ticket status

request.description:
**Purpose:** Admin resolves a complaint ticket and attaches resolution notes.
**Access Level:** 🛡️ ADMIN ONLY.

item.name: Notifications
item.description:
**Purpose:** Returns paginated list of notification alerts (new connections, appointments booked, wallet top-ups).
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Retrieve user's in-app notifications

query.description: If true, only returns unread notifications.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns paginated list of notification alerts (new connections, appointments booked, wallet top-ups).
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Get total count of unread notifications

request.description:
**Purpose:** Lightweight endpoint for badge counters on notification bell icons.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Mark all user notifications as read

request.description:
**Purpose:** Sets `isRead: true` across all notifications for the current user.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Mark specific notification as read

request.description:
**Purpose:** Marks a single notification item as read when clicked.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Connect to real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream

request.description:
**Purpose:** Establishes a persistent SSE connection to receive live push alerts instantly without polling.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Support
item.description:
**Purpose:** Allows parents or tutors to raise a support issue (e.g. appointment dispute, billing inquiry, tutor conduct).
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT or TUTOR).

item.name: Submit a new support complaint or ticket

request.description:
**Purpose:** Allows parents or tutors to raise a support issue (e.g. appointment dispute, billing inquiry, tutor conduct).
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT or TUTOR).

item.name: List complaints submitted by logged-in user

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns status updates and admin responses for all tickets filed by this user.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Reviews
item.description:
**Purpose:** Returns all approved and published reviews for a tutor, including individual ratings,
written feedback, subjects, and tutor public replies.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public.

item.name: Get public reviews & ratings distribution for a tutor

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns all approved and published reviews for a tutor, including individual ratings,
written feedback, subjects, and tutor public replies.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public.

item.name: Get featured platform testimonials for landing page

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns highest-rated platform testimonials to showcase on public marketing pages.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public.

item.name: Submit a review and rating

request.description:
**Purpose:** Allows a Parent to rate a Tutor (1 to 5 stars) after a completed appointment,
or allows any user to submit platform feedback. Automatically recalculates the tutor's average rating.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT).

item.name: Tutor or Parent reply to a received review

request.description:
**Purpose:** Allows the tutor to write a public response to feedback received on their profile.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Appointments
item.description:
**Purpose:** Returns all scheduled appointments.
- If **Parent**: Returns booked sessions, tutor profiles, dates, and modes.
- If **Tutor**: Returns student appointments, parent contact details, and locations.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT or TUTOR).

item.name: Get appointments for the authenticated user

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns all scheduled appointments.
- If **Parent**: Returns booked sessions, tutor profiles, dates, and modes.
- If **Tutor**: Returns student appointments, parent contact details, and locations.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT or TUTOR).

item.name: Book a new tutoring appointment

request.description:
**Purpose:** Allows a Parent to book a tutoring appointment with a connected tutor for a specific child, date, and time.
**Access Level:** 👨‍👩‍👧 PARENT ONLY.

body.raw:
{
  "tutorId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
  "childId": "c1b2a3d4-e5f6-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d",
  "date": "2026-10-25",
  "startTime": "16:00",
  "endTime": "17:00",
  "subject": "Mathematics",
  "mode": "ONLINE",
  "notes": "Please focus on derivative problems from chapter 4."
}

item.name: Retrieve single appointment details

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns complete details for a specific appointment.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Update appointment status (Confirm, Complete, or Cancel)

request.description:
**Purpose:** Updates the appointment lifecycle.
- Tutor can confirm (`CONFIRMED`) or complete (`COMPLETED`).
- Either party can cancel (`CANCELLED`) with a cancellation reason.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Wallet
item.description:
**Purpose:** Returns the user's available coin balance, expiry dates, and full historical credit/debit transactions.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT).

item.name: Retrieve live coin balance and transaction ledger

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns the user's available coin balance, expiry dates, and full historical credit/debit transactions.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT).

item.name: Get available coin purchase packages

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns available coin bundles with prices in INR, bonus coins, and validity duration.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Top up wallet with coins (internal or after payment confirmation)

request.description:
**Purpose:** Credits coins to the user's wallet with validity calculation and transaction ledger creation.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Atomically deduct coins from wallet

request.description:
**Purpose:** Deducts coins for platform actions (e.g., unlocking contact details). Ensures atomic safety against race conditions.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Payments
item.description:
**Purpose:** Initiates a payment session by generating an official `order_id` via the Razorpay API.
The frontend uses this `order_id` to launch the Razorpay Checkout modal.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT).

item.name: Create a Razorpay payment order

request.description:
**Purpose:** Initiates a payment session by generating an official `order_id` via the Razorpay API.
The frontend uses this `order_id` to launch the Razorpay Checkout modal.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT).

item.name: Verify Razorpay payment signature & credit wallet

request.description:
**Purpose:** Cryptographically verifies the `razorpay_signature` generated by Razorpay using HMAC SHA256
with the `RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET`. Upon verification, the user's wallet is credited with coins automatically.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Handle Razorpay bank redirect callback

request.description:
**Purpose:** Webhook/callback endpoint called by the user's bank after 3D-Secure OTP verification.
Redirects the user back to the frontend success or failure page.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public (Invoked by Razorpay / Bank Gateway).

item.name: Connections
item.description:
**Purpose:** Returns all connection relationships for the authenticated user.
- If **Parent**: Returns requested tutors, connection statuses, and unlocked contact info.
- If **Tutor**: Returns student connection leads, messages, and parent contact details.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT or TUTOR).

item.name: Get list of active and pending connections

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns all connection relationships for the authenticated user.
- If **Parent**: Returns requested tutors, connection statuses, and unlocked contact info.
- If **Tutor**: Returns student connection leads, messages, and parent contact details.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT or TUTOR).

item.name: Request new connection or update connection status

request.description:
**Purpose:** Dual-action connection endpoint:
1. **Parent Requesting Tutor:** Pass `tutorId`, `subject`, and optional `message`.
   Deducts 50 coins from Parent wallet automatically.
2. **Tutor Responding to Request:** Pass `connectionId` and `status` (`ACCEPTED` or `REJECTED`).
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Users
item.description:
**Purpose:** Returns profile details of the logged-in user. If PARENT, returns parent details and registered children.
If TUTOR, returns professional bio, hourly rate, pincode, and subjects.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT, TUTOR, or ADMIN).

item.name: Retrieve currently authenticated user profile

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns profile details of the logged-in user. If PARENT, returns parent details and registered children.
If TUTOR, returns professional bio, hourly rate, pincode, and subjects.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT, TUTOR, or ADMIN).

item.name: Update profile details (Universal for Parent or Tutor)

request.description:
**Purpose:** Updates personal information, location, pincode, city, bio, and associated child profiles.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (PARENT or TUTOR).

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Dr. Sarah Smith",
  "city": "Khammam",
  "pincode": "507122",
  "location": "Khammam, Telangana, 507122",
  "headline": "Special Educator & Senior Math Tutor",
  "bio": "Experienced educator with 10+ years specializing in personalized learning.",
  "hourlyRate": 600,
  "teachingMode": "BOTH",
  "children": ""
}

item.name: Upload file (avatar, certificate, ID proof) to Cloudinary

request.description:
**Purpose:** Uploads multipart binary file to Cloudinary cloud storage under folder `tutor_platform_media`
and returns the permanent HTTPS secure URL.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session.

item.name: Get tutor portal dashboard metrics & analytics

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns high-level metrics for the logged-in tutor: total profile views, active leads,
completed appointments, and average rating.
**Access Level:** 🎓 TUTOR ONLY.

item.name: Search
item.description:
**Purpose:** Searches tutors based on location, pincode, subject, category, teaching mode, and budget.
Basic profile cards are public for SEO, while contact details (email/phone) are masked until a connection is unlocked.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public (Accessible to parents, guests, and authenticated users).

item.name: Search & filter approved tutors in marketplace

query.description: Keyword search matching tutor name, headline, bio, or location.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Searches tutors based on location, pincode, subject, category, teaching mode, and budget.
Basic profile cards are public for SEO, while contact details (email/phone) are masked until a connection is unlocked.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public (Accessible to parents, guests, and authenticated users).

item.name: Retrieve detailed public profile of a specific tutor

variable.description: Tutor User UUID or Profile UUID.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns comprehensive professional details of a tutor including educational qualifications,
subjects taught, bio, hourly rate, and teaching mode. Contact information remains protected.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
**Purpose:** Creates a new user in the platform. Supports registering as either a `PARENT` or `TUTOR`.
If registering as a Tutor, an automated onboarding profile and approval request is initialized.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public (No authentication required).

item.name: Register a new Parent or Tutor account

request.description:
**Purpose:** Creates a new user in the platform. Supports registering as either a `PARENT` or `TUTOR`.
If registering as a Tutor, an automated onboarding profile and approval request is initialized.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public (No authentication required).

exec: console.log('JWT Token captured and saved to collection variable {{token}}');

item.name: Authenticate user & retrieve JWT token

request.description:
**Purpose:** Authenticates user using email or phone and password. Generates a secure JWT token valid for 7 days.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public.

exec: console.log('JWT Token captured and saved to collection variable {{token}}');

item.name: Send OTP to phone for registration or password reset

request.description:
**Purpose:** Generates a 6-digit one-time password and delivers it via the configured SMS gateway (SPEAR UC).
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public.

item.name: Reset account password using verified OTP

request.description:
**Purpose:** Updates user password after successfully verifying the OTP sent to their phone number.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Public.

item.name: Change password for active authenticated session

request.description:
**Purpose:** Allows logged-in users (Parents, Tutors, Admins) to update their account password by providing their current password.
**Access Level:** 🔒 Authenticated Session (Any Role).

item.name: End authenticated session

request.description:
**Purpose:** Safely logs out the user and signals the client to discard the JWT token.
**Access Level:** 🌐 Optional Auth (Idempotent).
